name: admin
description: Optional password-protected admin area. Off by default; other modules add pages to it.

ADMIN_PATH.description: Where the admin area lives. If you change it, change config/routes.d/admin.php to match. The password is NOT set here — run scripts/admin-password.php, which writes config/admin-password.hash.

ADMIN_STEALTH.description: Set to 1 and an unauthenticated visitor gets the site's ordinary 404 instead of a login form, so the admin area is not discoverable by probing.
